title: ‘The blood of these brothers cries out’: Pope Leo demands justice for people killed protecting the Amazon
summary_full: Pontiff delivers forceful speech in Peru as he travels from high in the Andes into the AmazonPope Leo XIV has demanded justice for environmental defenders killed for protecting the Amazon and backed efforts by Indigenous peoples to stop their lands from being ravaged by logging and illegal mining.On the penultimate day of his South American tour, Leo on Sunday travelled into the Peruvian Amazon and channelled one of Pope Francis’s core teachings that links care for the most vulnerable with care for God’s creation.
